questions.q: In the SOQL question about closed won amount by owner this fiscal year, what does THIS_FISCAL_YEAR do?
options: It always means the last 365 days
It is a date literal that respects the org's fiscal year setting
questions.explain: THIS_FISCAL_YEAR is a SOQL date literal based on the org's fiscal year definition, so it is worth confirming that setting.

questions.q: A dashboard total does not match a report total. Which is a common first thing to check?
options: The size of the browser window
The dashboard's running user, filters and refresh time
questions.explain: The running user controls visible records, and dashboard filters and refresh timing can also cause differences from a report.

questions.q: A custom report type helps with which kind of question?
options: Accounts with no related cases, using the with-or-without option
questions.explain: When standard report types do not expose the relationship you need, a custom report type can, including a with-or-without setup for records lacking related records.

questions.q: You find duplicate leads before reporting. What is the best approach?
options: Measure the problem, agree a rule with the data owner, and document what you excluded
questions.explain: Quantify, agree a survivor rule with the business, and document the treatment. Silent deletion undermines trust.

questions.q: You are asked an interview question you do not know the answer to. What is a strong response?
options: Say what you would check and how you would find out
questions.explain: Interviewers value reasoning and honesty. Explaining your approach to finding the answer is stronger than guessing.
